title: Zesty Creamy Ukrainian Brie Pasta
description: A tangy and creamy Ukrainian dish featuring brie cheese, infused oil, and shojin-friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe combines the richness of brie with the brightness of Ukrainian flavors.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the infused oil over medium heat.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they start to release their juices.
Add the brie cheese to the skillet and stir until it starts to melt.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the cheese and tomatoes.
Stir in the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with chopped parsley and dill.
Garnish with additional parsley and dill if desired.
Pair with a side of steamed vegetables for a well-rounded meal.
